SystemC 3.0 BL0SS0M MOD.0 - L4vender — i386 distribution files

systemc-i386.krn is the freestanding ELF32/Intel 80386 kernel. Run ../build.sh on a machine with the build dependencies to create SystemC-3.0-i386.iso in this directory. The ISO builder validates the legacy BIOS El Torito boot entry and embedded files before publishing the output.
